text: Every mammal is a vertebrate. Some whales are mammals. Therefore some whales are vertebrates.
Some philosophers are Greeks. Zeno is a Greek. Therefore some Greeks are philosophers.
Socrates is a philosopher. Socrates is wise. Therefore some philosophers are wise.
Mars is a planet. No planets are stars. Some wanderers are planets. Therefore some wanderers are not stars.
All metals conduct heat. Some alloys are metals. Therefore some alloys conduct heat.
No reptiles nurse young. Some lizards are reptiles. Therefore some lizards do not nurse young.
Some canaries are songbirds. All songbirds are perchers. All perchers are agile. Therefore some canaries are agile.
Aristotle is a philosopher. All philosophers are scholars. Therefore some scholars are philosophers.
Some tortoises are ancient. Therefore some tortoises are ancient.
Some hermits are not sociable. Therefore some hermits are not sociable.
Every goose is a bird. Some geese are gray. Therefore some birds are gray.
No fish are mammals. Therefore some fish are mammals.
Every square is a rectangle. Therefore some squares are not rectangles.
Bede is a monk. No monks are talkative. Some scribes are monks. Therefore Bede is talkative.
Nile is a river. All rivers are wet. Some rivers are wide. Therefore Nile is not wet.
Some sailors are brave. Magellan is a sailor. Therefore Magellan is brave.
All unicorns are horned. Therefore some unicorns are horned.
Some auks are flightless. Some auks are colorful. Therefore some flightless are colorful.
Vega is a star. Vega is not visible. Therefore some stars are visible.
Some poems are sonnets. No plays rhyme. Therefore some poems do not rhyme.
Some larks sing. Therefore some larks sing sweetly.
Some of the sailors are brave. Therefore some sailors are brave.
Some sailors were brave. Therefore some sailors are brave.
Some sailors did not return. Therefore some sailors return.
If some sailors are brave then the ship sails. Some sailors are brave. Therefore the ship sails.
Most sailors are brave. Therefore some sailors are brave.
Some sailors are brave. Therefore all sailors are brave.
Some sailors does not sail. Therefore some sailors sail.
Some old sailors whittle driftwood. Therefore some sailors whittle driftwood.
Some sailors who fish are brave. Therefore some sailors are brave.
Some sailors are the crew. Therefore some crew are sailors.
Some sailors are brave. Do some sailors sing?
